max_tire.note: INEOS Forum consensus sweet spot with no rub, but you'll probably need washers under the spare carrier to clear the small rear door. 285/70R17 fits without fuss; DVA Mechanics lists 295/70R17 as 'stock or 40 mm lift'.

DVA Mechanics lists 35s as needing at least 2 in of lift. Expect an aftermarket or offset spare carrier, and match the spare to the road tyres because the permanent 4WD centre diff doesn't like mismatched diameters.

items.title: Steering rod ball-joint nuts may not lock
items.summary: Non-locking nuts may have been fitted to the steering rod ball joint; 61 trucks covered.

items.title: Auxiliary switch relay wire can short (fire risk)
items.summary: The relay control wire may be trapped under the power-cable fastener, damaging insulation; 727 trucks with the auxiliary switch package.

items.title: Door may not latch fully
items.summary: Door button mechanisms assembled with too little grease can stop the door latching; 7,022 trucks covered.

timeline.change: Exterior revealed online on 1 July; INEOS buys the Smart plant at Hambach, France, in December
Production starts at Hambach; first deliveries in December
First US-bound trucks leave the factory in September for MY2024; B58 petrol only
Early US trucks covered by recalls 23V903, 23V828 and 25V147; check they're closed
Factory stops from September 2024 to January 2025 over a parts-supply problem
Variable-ratio steering box with more assist, revised HVAC, quieter driver assists, Black Edition

identify.intro: Every Grenadier looks the same from 20 paces, but lockers, steering and trim packs vary a lot.

items.head: Lockers (Rough Pack)
items.body: The centre diff lock (lever) is standard. Front and rear lockers come with the Rough Pack, standard on the Trialmaster and a $2,850 option on base and Fieldmaster at US launch. Look for the locker switches in the overhead panel.

items.head: Trialmaster or Fieldmaster
items.body: Trialmaster adds the Rough Pack (lockers, BFG KO2s), raised air intake, auxiliary battery and switch panel. Fieldmaster brings Safari windows, leather and heated front seats.

items.head: Steering generation
items.body: Pre-2026 trucks have a Bosch hydraulic recirculating-ball box with almost four turns lock to lock. MY2026 trucks get a variable-ratio worm-gear box with more assist.

items.head: Engine and market
items.body: US trucks all have the BMW B58 3.0 petrol six (282 hp). The B57 diesel and the two- or five-seat Utility Wagon commercial were sold in other markets.

items.head: Recall status
items.body: Run the VIN at NHTSA. MY2024 US trucks can carry all three campaigns.

capability.v: 150 kg (330 lb) dynamic, 420 kg (925 lb) static

values.intro: Used trucks sit well under new-truck money, so a lightly used 2024 is the value play; the MY2026 steering update is the reason to buy new.

ranges.cond: Used 2024, typical Bring a Trailer sale

values.note: Based on 12 Bring a Trailer sales of 2024 Grenadier Station Wagons between March 2025 and September 2026 ($56,500–92,500, median about $65,750); two 2025 trucks sold for $61,500 and $63,000, and an armored 2024 was bid to $95,000 without selling. New prices: base $71,000, Fieldmaster and Trialmaster $79,000, Black Edition $82,995, plus about $1,995 destination.
